title: Vote on PyIceberg 0.12.0rc1
summary: Alex Stephen proposed release candidate 1 as the official PyIceberg 0.12.0 release, with a 72-hour vote. The highlighted features were view support, geometry and geography type support, Python 3.14 support, a new File Format API, and many bug fixes and improvements. Four non-binding +1 votes followed, with verification of signatures, checksums, license headers and tests on macOS and Linux. One voter noted a pre-existing flaky test, `test_add_files_parallelized`, which fails on machines with many cores. Kevin Liu then cast a binding -1 because a user had reported a regression, issue #3758, which he was able to validate; since it is a correctness issue he asked to fix it and raise a new release candidate. The thread ends with that vote and contains no closing message from the release manager.

positions.stance: Votes +1 (non-binding) and notes that `test_add_files_parallelized` is a pre-existing flaky test that fails on high-core machines.
Votes -1 (binding): a validated regression reported in issue #3758 is a correctness issue, so it should be fixed and a new RC raised.

outcome.note: No result message in the thread. Votes cast: four non-binding +1 and one binding -1, with the -1 asking for a fix and a new release candidate.

why_it_matters: A correctness regression found during the vote means PyIceberg 0.12.0 needs another release candidate.
